Application Data.NAME: Mart Discount Store
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Mart Discount Store is a department and discount retailer that provides a wide range of merchandise, including clothing, home goods, and electronics, all at competitive prices. We focus on providing value to our customers through a modern shopping experience and exceptional customer service. Our store features a well-organized layout, seasonal promotions, and a loyalty program that rewards frequent shoppers. We also emphasize community engagement by participating in local events and supporting local charities.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2023, a slip and fall incident occurred in the electronics section due to a wet floor, leading to a claim of $2,000. The claim has been settled, and the status is closed. Additionally, on 05/10/2023, merchandise valued at $1,250 was stolen during a shoplifting incident. The claim is currently under review with the insurance adjuster.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter, two watchpersons on-site during operating hours, and a 24/7 monitored alarm system.
